opis: The children's room from the reference picture at night, lit only by the small warm bedside lamp and the moon through the window. On the big round blue rug in the middle the FOX, the SQUIRREL, the OWL and the ROE DEER lie asleep side by side under soft blankets, EACH with its head on its OWN white PILLOW (exactly four pillows under four heads), eyes closed, smiling in their sleep. A few white feathers still lie on the rug from the pillow fight. Outside the window, in the dark blue sky by the crescent moon, a little swirl of glowing yellow fireflies dances. Quiet, cosy and sleepy - goodnight.
